property_summary: For any caller and amount, only the contract owner can make C.sendMoney(...) succeed (i.e. causes the low-level call to be attempted and the contract balance to decrease by the sent amount when caller is owner); the mutant inverts onlyOwner so there exist callers/amounts where the owner cannot send and a non-owner can, making address(c).balance behave differently.
change_summary: Change onlyOwner modifier to require msg.sender is not the owner (inverting the access control).
